newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Sept 22.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Sept 22.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
An investigation team found weak tracks and high temperature that buckled the line as the causes of the September 14 train accident near Dhaka which killed at least eight people.

Bangladesh embassy in the United Arab Emirates has so far issued exit passes to some 30,000 Bangladeshis facing deportation by the UAE government. Bangladesh ambassador to UAE Zia-ul-Shams Chowdhury said thousands of Bangladeshis were crowding airline offices to purchase a one-way ticket to go home.
Biman Bangladesh airlines will operate 39 flights during the current month to airlift about 6,000 Bangladehis facing deportation from the United Arab Emirates under a new immigration law.
Nearly 3,000 people die every year in road accidents in Bangladesh, according to a study report.
The government has asked state-owned commercial banks to release over 2.0 billion taka ($50 million) for jute purchase to ensure fair price to the farmers, Finance Minister S A M S Kibria said.
About 30 percent of Bangladesh's rural areas would be brought under electrification by the year 2,000, government officials said. Currently 19 percent of the villages has power supply.
